drive.description: Drive identifier: a, b, softiec (or "IEC Drive"), or a bus number such as 8 or drive8.

description:
Drive operations.

Operations:
- reset [write]: Issue an IEC reset for the selected drive slot. Required: drive.
- power_on [write]: Power on a specific Ultimate drive slot. Required: drive.
- power_off [write]: Power off a specific Ultimate drive slot. Required: drive.
- load_rom [c64u, u2] [destructive]: Temporarily load a custom ROM into an Ultimate drive slot. Required: drive, path.
- set_mode [write]: Set the emulation mode for a drive slot (1541/1571/1581). Required: drive, mode.
